map_note: County boards' own data runs ahead of the state's daily dashboard; where a county's figure is higher, it is used. Butler, Clermont, Crawford, Franklin, Hamilton, Henry, Morrow and Trumbull publish voter-level lists that include each voter's party, so their party splits are used too. Cuyahoga reports totals only, so the extra ballots count in totals but not party shares. Butler (as of 2026-10-16 03:01): early in person 11,435 (state 9,855); ballots sent 15,452 (state 15,046). Clermont (as of 2026-10-16 02:43): mail returned 2,476 (state 2,439); early in person 5,239 (state 4,493). Crawford (as of 2026-10-15 15:29): mail returned 438 (state 427); early in person 1,084 (state 922). Cuyahoga (as of 2026-10-15 17:04): mail returned 26,002 (state 18,574); early in person 12,449 (state 10,964). Franklin (as of 2026-10-16 00:12): mail returned 15,763 (state 13,194); early in person 25,679 (state 22,269); ballots sent 76,079 (state 74,609). Hamilton (as of 2026-10-14 19:07): early in person 16,741 (state 16,594). Henry (as of 2026-10-15 15:30): early in person 989 (state 868). Morrow (as of 2026-10-15 16:13): mail returned 346 (state 275); early in person 1,032 (state 914). Trumbull (as of 2026-10-15 07:28): mail returned 2,408 (state 2,406).
